For Sale by Private Treaty
7 Ballinwillin
Mitchelstown   
Co. Cork

4/5-Bedroom House. C.1326sqft
Guide: €325,000
Michael Dorgan Auctioneers & Valuers are delighted to present new to the market, this immaculately presented 4/5 bedroom family home within a short distance of the town centre. Offering bright spacious living accommodation, a superb location only a short walk from the amenities of Mitchelstown town centre on the foothills of the Galtee Mountains. A short commute from Cork, Limerick & Clonmel. Viewing strictly by appointment. 



Location:
Located just off the Dublin Rd, 2 minutes walk from Mitchelstown town centre with its wealth of amenities, Living Health Clinic, schools & shops. This property is just 3.9km from Junction 13 of the M8 Motorway & just 30minutes from the Jack Lynch Tunnel.



Features:
Large sqft, unheard of in new builds today c.1326sqft. 
Quality built by local company. (Concrete)
Mains water & sewerage, OFCH
Areas are set out in Lawn, tarmacadam & patio.
Off street parking. Wide side access.
Mature trees and shrubs.
Just over 30 minutes from the Jack Lynch Tunnel.
2 minutes from the town and amenities 
Excellent rental potential with up to 5 bedrooms, 3 w/c.
